title: myriandra adpressa
intro: Myriandra adpressa, commonly known as the Australian hawthorn, is a plant species native to the eastern and southern regions of Australia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, and to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Myriandra adpressa include its use as a cardiac tonic, to improve circulation and reduce the risk of heart disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
